name: gymmy
description: Find gyms and studios, see classes and prices, and book with Gymmy.

interface.longDescription: Gymmy is the booking and management platform of independent gyms and studios in France and Europe (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxing, martial arts, dance). Ask your assistant to find a gym near you, see its class schedule and prices, and get a trial class link. Connect your Gymmy account to see your bookings, book a class with your membership or cancel one, under your gym's own rules. Gyms not on Gymmy yet come from OpenStreetMap and are clearly marked as not bookable. Support: contact@hellogymmy.fr
defaultPrompt: Find a CrossFit gym near Lyon.
What classes are on tomorrow at my gym?

positive.prompt: Find a CrossFit gym near Lyon.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists CrossFit gyms near Lyon. Gymmy gyms are bookable with a link; OpenStreetMap listings are flagged as not on Gymmy / not bookable.

positive.prompt: What classes are on tomorrow at Box Agents?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows tomorrow's classes at that gym with times and a link per class.

positive.prompt: How much is a membership there, and can I try a class?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the gym's offers with EUR prices and sign-up links, and gives a trial class link. Nothing is booked or charged.
After connecting with the reviewer account, lists the member's upcoming booked and waitlisted classes at Gymmy Demo.

positive.prompt: Book me into the next open class this week. Then: Cancel that booking.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next open class, asks the user to confirm before booking, books it with the member's membership (no payment), then cancels it on request within the gym's cancel deadline.

negative.prompt: Pay my gym membership with my credit card.

negative.description: No booking without confirmation or at non-Gymmy gyms
negative.prompt: Book me a class at a gym that is not on Gymmy.
Write me a 4-week marathon training plan with medical advice.

review.commerce_description: Gymmy does not sell or charge anything in the assistant. Bookings use the member's existing membership; no payment data reaches the assistant.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: gym search, schedules, prices, trial links, and member bookings.

fr-FR.subtitle: Trouve et réserve tes cours
fr-FR.description: Gymmy est la plateforme de réservation et de gestion des salles et studios indépendants en France et en Europe (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxe, arts martiaux, danse). Demande à ton assistant de trouver une salle près de chez toi, de voir son planning et ses tarifs, et d’obtenir un lien de séance d’essai. Connecte ton compte Gymmy pour voir tes réservations, réserver un cours avec ton abonnement ou l’annuler, selon les règles de ta salle. Les salles pas encore sur Gymmy viennent d’OpenStreetMap et sont signalées comme non réservables.
